character.name: Autor — pele queimada, sem barba

Split vertically into TWO halves: one half is burnt charred human flesh coated with glossy black oil, the other half is exposed ivory SKELETON ribs skull jaw arm and leg, NO blood. A small clearly readable TRUCK passes HORIZONTALLY THROUGH his belly, cab and wheels visible at waist. ONE arm ends in a GIANT hooked metal pirate hook, other hand is intact. Wear Kuma-inspired white rounded cap with black bear-like spots and small rounded bear ear shapes, and Doflamingo-inspired sharp pink wing-shaped sunglasses. Oily scorched pirate costume remnants around enormous torso, thin boots below. All unusual requested traits visible simultaneously: half burnt flesh/half skeleton, embedded truck, giant hook, white spotted cap, pink pointed sunglasses. Full body ready standing pose, hook lowered, high top-down crisp outlined chibi fantasy tactical pixel art consistent with Arena Tatica. No extra limbs, no background, no scenery, no text.
